data.name: SmartBpTooltipAiRecognitionInterval
data.value: Controls time between AI screenshots. An interval below actual inference time causes stale queued results and slower stopping. Run the speed test first; the minimum is measured maximum elapsed + 250ms.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipPhaseCropWidth
data.value: Maximum phase crop width. Smaller is faster and uses less VRAM but can lose text. Recommended 480–768; rerun the speed test after changing it.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipContentCropWidth
data.value: Maximum BP content crop width. Smaller is faster but may lose text or portrait detail. Recommended 640–1280; rerun the speed test after changing it.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipPhaseTokens
data.value: Maximum phase output tokens. Too few truncates JSON; too many can generate longer. Recommended 32–128, default 48.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipSnapshotTokens
data.value: Maximum snapshot delta output tokens. Too few truncates JSON; too many can add latency. Recommended 256–1536 depending on requested fields.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipCommitHold
data.value: Briefly waits for the preceding recognition/apply before guidance moves. Too short may miss a step; too long delays UI. AI usually needs 250–1000ms.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipVisualBuffer
data.value: Extra delay before applying current-step results. Default 0; use only to stabilize animation. Large values make BP visibly lag. Recommended 0–500ms.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipStrictCandidateEnums
data.value: Adds the character candidate list to the AI JSON schema. This reduces invented names but increases schema processing and may be incompatible with some models. Disable it on schema errors or added latency.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipRapidOcrMaxSideLen
data.value: A larger side may improve small text at the cost of memory and speed. Keep 1024 unless tuning.

data.name: SmartBpTooltipRapidOcrThresholds
data.value: Higher thresholds reduce false positives but can miss weak or small text.
